title: The King's Barrow
text: The greatest barrow of all, a hill raised over a king, its door sealed with his seal in black wax as big as a shield. The seal is broken. Cold air pours out of the gap, and with it a smell of old gold and newer blood.

options.label: Go into the king's barrow, and see what the robbers woke.

outcomes.text: Someone came before you, and woke what was inside, and it is still awake, and still angry.

options.label: The sharpest eye follows the robbers' tracks, to take back what they stole.

outcomes.text: To their camp, and the king's crown, and the robbers, who are not glad to see you.

options.label: Reseal the king's door, and let him rest as he was meant to.

outcomes.text: The king thanks you in a dream, and his hand on your shoulder is cold and strong.
